summary: Comprehensive frontend E2E testing of NotaKalk PWA (client-side only, no backend). Tested all 13 acceptance areas: Enter-loop parser, format variants, error handling, item actions (edit/duplicate/move/delete), discount modes, memo, save+IndexedDB persistence after reload, history navigation/duplicate/delete with confirm dialog, copy action, settings (theme persistence, print, sample data, export download, delete-all, privacy-info), mobile action dock, total consistency, and PWA (manifest 200 + display=standalone + SW registered). Everything passed with no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: No critical issues found. Codebase is well-structured with data-testid coverage on all interactive elements as documented.
receipt-discount displays value without explicit label prefix ('-100' for 10% of 1000) — acceptable per spec but could optionally show 'Diskon' label alongside for clarity.
seed_data_creation: Used built-in 'Muat contoh data' (load-sample-btn) which creates 3 sample notes (today/yesterday/2 days ago). Cleaned via delete-all-btn after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is 100% client-side PWA on Vite. Backend FastAPI template is running but unused per spec — skip backend testing. HashRouter routes: /#/, /#/history, /#/settings, /#/note/{id}. Public URL from frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All interactive elements have kebab-case data-testid. Main textarea intercepts Enter for parse; Shift+Enter for newline. IndexedDB db='notakalk'. Test data can be seeded via Settings → 'Muat contoh data'. Verified: parser variants (space/x/X/*/thousand-separator), error messages inline (unrecognized + incomplete-price), all item menu actions at index-based testids, discount percent/nominal/none, memo→receipt-note, save + reload persistence via IndexedDB draft, history menu duplicate/delete-with-confirm-dialog, copy-note-inline toast 'Teks nota disalin', theme dark persisted after reload (html.dark), export downloads nota-backup-YYYYMMDD.json, delete-all confirm dialog works, mobile action-dock at 390x844 renders all buttons, total consistency between receipt-total and dock-total, manifest.webmanifest returns 200 with display=standalone, 1 service worker registered, no console errors.
